The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Multiple cells in the range H46:L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected floating-point values (e.g., H46 expected -1.7216, got #NAME?). This typically indicates the use of undefined function names or incorrect syntax in the Excel formulas generated for the 'Task' worksheet.
